1. ESTABLISH - RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA H
ESTABLISH - 2-HOUR PARKING, MON-FRI FROM 8 AM TO 6 PM EXCEPT FOR VEHICLES WITH

North side of the 300 block of Eucalyptus Drive between 20th Avenue and 22nd Avenue, 300 block of
Eucalyptus Drive (Supervisor District 4) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Raynell Cooper,
[staff email removed — see the order]

This proposal adds RPP regulation to 2-hour parking, Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM on North
side of the 300 block of Eucalyptus Drive between 20th and 22nd Avenues to conform with the
existing regulations on 21st and 22nd Avenues in RPP Area H.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.

26th Avenue, west side, from 29 feet to 100 feet north of Geary Boulevard (six front-in angled
parking spaces) (Supervisor District 1) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Daniel Mackowski,
[staff email removed — see the order]



Proposal, in response to a request from Holy Virgin Cathedral, for new parking meters to encourage
parking turnover and to facilitate visitor access. There are eight angled parking spaces on 26th
Avenue, west side, north of Geary Boulevard. Currently, the first two spaces closest to Geary have
parking meters installed.

Public Comments: Emails and comments in support.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
